description: Sonic 1 website hero loop: multi-zone montage, hard cuts, fade at the loop ends.

shots.label: Green Hill Act 2: loop and rings
Scrap Brain Act 1: Sonic 2 lends its art and spin dash
shots.note: Cross-game donation from Sonic 2, driven by the complete run from the level start.

shots.label: Special Stage 1: rotating maze
shots.note: GHZ1 played from its recorded level start; the stage is entered through the giant ring by the movie's own input.

shots.label: Star Light Act 1: running against a fan
shots.note: Declared start on the platform right of the always-on fan at x 0x0A08; he runs left into its wind, then skids and is blown right.

shots.label: Scrap Brain Act 2: hit by a spike ball, then rewound
shots.note: Declared start and the 26 rings the complete run carried; the wait puts the swinging ball in the recorded run's phase. Holding the live rewind key undoes the hit, and the retry waits for the ball to pass.

shots.label: Spring Yard Act 3: waiting impatiently on the block lifts
shots.note: Declared start where the complete run stands on the moving blocks; left idle long enough for the foot-tapping wait animation.

shots.label: Scrap Brain Act 2: ten Sonic sidekicks on their own CPU
shots.note: Sonic 1 takes sidekicks only with a donor game; Sonic 2 lends its art. The leader leaves the recorded line at the first wall, and the ten followers scatter and jump to catch up.

shots.label: Green Hill Act 2: Super Sonic, borrowed from Sonic 2
shots.note: Declared setup: six emeralds and 60 rings; a second jump press in the air transforms him, then he runs through the Crabmeat ledge and the enemies beyond.
